## What lives here
The backend's pytest suite (63 test files). No test calls a model or the Tool Service; conftest isolates settings and knowledge and signs requests in.

## Conventions
Tests are named after the behaviour they pin; many start from a recorded real failure, quoted in the docstring.

## Entry points
`python -m pytest tests -q` from `backend/`.
